claims.statement: The new Construction Products Regulation provides for a construction digital product passport system and persistent product identifiers.
The Commission launched a DPP Registry with user-interface and API access in July 2026.

contrary_evidence: Open standards and anti-lock-in requirements reduce proprietary control of raw passport data.
The construction-specific delegated arrangements are not yet fully settled.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: partner with notified bodies, BIM vendors, and building-material distributors.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1,500 manufacturers and 150,000 hosted SKUs could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in seven to ten years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: template-based onboarding keeps founder work below 18 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: standardized hosting could reach 80% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: acquisition pays back within five months for a manufacturer with 60 SKUs.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 90 PLN per SKU monthly plus 2,000 PLN onboarding.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: persistent availability, translation, and declaration updates drive retention.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A normalized material-property graph and translation memory reduce onboarding cost and improve search
fingerprint.customer: CEE construction-product manufacturers and cross-border distributors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Notified-body referrals and distributor catalog integrations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Multilingual passport creation, evidence linking, API hosting, and update subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays when a product identity is published and continuously hosted
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product type needs an accessible, accurate declaration and persistent digital identity

founder_fit: The product favors structured data, AI extraction, and low-camera B2B work.
The family installation channel can test downstream document usability.
risks: Large ERP and BIM vendors can add passport modules quickly.
Incorrect declarations could expose the operator to contractual claims.

structure.control_point: Persistent product identifier linking declarations, technical evidence, and distributor access
structure.critical_dependency: Manufacturer adoption and conformity with forthcoming delegated technical arrangements

thesis: Become the shared product-identity and declaration exchange for small CEE construction-material manufacturers and distributors.
title: Construction Product Passport Exchange
uncertainties: The first mandatory product families and willingness to pay remain uncertain.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
